# Pin tables

The GPIO numbers each example uses, by chip. They are the constants at the top of the sketch.

The chips: **ESP32** is the original, **ESP32-S3** the common DevKitC, **C3 / C6 / S2** share the third column. Change the numbers in the sketch if your wiring differs.

## 10_GpsTracker: GPS tracker

| Signal | Connects to | ESP32 | ESP32-S3 | C3 / C6 / S2 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `GPS_RX` | GPS module TX | 16 | 18 | 10 |
| `GPS_TX` | GPS module RX | 17 | 17 | 0 |

## 11_GpsGeofence: GPS geofence

| Signal | Connects to | ESP32 | ESP32-S3 | C3 / C6 / S2 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `GPS_RX` | GPS module TX | 16 | 18 | 10 |
| `GPS_TX` | GPS module RX | 17 | 17 | 0 |
| `RELAY` | Relay board IN | 25 | 4 | 5 |

## 12_TftStatus: TFT status screen

| Signal | Connects to | ESP32 | ESP32-S3 | C3 / C6 / S2 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `SPI_SCK` | ST7789 240x240 panel SCL / SCK | 18 | 12 | 4 |
| `SPI_MOSI` | ST7789 240x240 panel SDA / MOSI | 23 | 11 | 6 |
| `TFT_CS` | ST7789 240x240 panel CS | 15 | 14 | 1 |
| `TFT_DC` | ST7789 240x240 panel DC | 2 | 15 | 2 |
| `TFT_RST` | ST7789 240x240 panel RES | 4 | 16 | not used |
| `TFT_BL` | ST7789 240x240 panel BLK | 32 | 21 | 3 |
